class.name: OcgAISCircle
class.brief_description: Constructs circle datums to be used in construction of composite shapes.
class.description: ! Constructs circle datums to be used in construction of ! composite shapes.

method.name: Type
method.description: Indicates that the type of Interactive Object is a datum.

method.name: Parameters
method.description: Constructs instances of the starting point and the end point parameters, theU1 and theU2.

method.name: SetFirstParam
method.description: Allows you to set the parameter theU for the starting point of an arc.

method.name: SetLastParam
method.description: Allows you to provide the parameter theU for the end point of an arc.

method.name: SetWidth
method.description: Assigns the width aValue to the solid line boundary of the circle datum.

method.name: UnsetColor
method.description: Removes color from the solid line boundary of the circle datum.

method.name: UnsetWidth
method.description: Removes width settings from the solid line boundary of the circle datum.

method.name: SetFilledCircleSens
method.description: Sets the type of sensitivity for the circle. If theIsFilledCircleSens set to true then the whole circle will be detectable, otherwise only the boundary of the circle.
